input: X11 XTest mouse and keyboard events
passed: Startup requests fullscreen and a native Escape key returns to windowed mode
A flow at the graph's first midnight preserves the opening value and the resulting balance
Native hover shows exact account balances, opening value, and both ends of a vertical change
Multiple accounts have distinct hover amounts; hidden lines stop responding until shown
Combined plotting preserves the same first instant and counts transfers once per endpoint
Missing starting balances are prominent for single, mixed, and combined account selections
Typed month/day values without leading zeros normalize and graph successfully
Invalid dates and reversed ranges display visible errors and clear stale graph contents
Both calendars select dates; month navigation, Escape, switching calendars, and outside click work without origin flashing
Resized graphs keep the date controls and edge hover labels visible
limitations: Xvfb has no window manager or physical monitor layout; this audit does not verify fullscreen placement across real monitors.
